[LEXP.5.11.3] **A coordinate that is not one gives NaN.** When either latitude
lies outside $[-90, 90]$ degrees, either longitude outside $[-180, 180]$ degrees,
or any argument is NaN or infinite, the engine must return NaN without evaluating [LEXP.5.11.2]'s composition. A `<`, `<=`, `>`,
`>=` or `==` comparison with a NaN is false ([LDET.3.6.2]), so a rule that compares the result with a
distance does not match it, and [LEXP.4.2] keeps it out of working memory.
